faq.q: What is the origin of Emraan?
faq.a: Emraan is associated with Hebrew. ʿImrān, the Arabic form of Amram, named in the Qur'an. The source record's gloss 'Protector, Guardian' is unsupported.
No — the underlying form is Hebrew, not Arabic.
Emraan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Hebrew-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Emraan should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. عمران is named in the Qur'an (e.g. 3:33)
